name: YakYak engine — resolve target, patch or new episode, render, post

nodes.name: Input event
nodes.notes: POST here to start. Body: { target: {mode: patch|episode, campaignId?, campaignName?, movieId?}, userId?, apiBase?, importData?, changes, chatWebhookUrl? }. Auth: the header set in the 'YakYak render webhook token' Header Auth credential (a shared multi-user instance must not expose an open webhook that spends render credits). userId enables adopt-by-name, import, ownership check and the trailer/template default — it can no longer be decoded from the token, which lives in the 'YakYak API' credential.

nodes.name: When called by workflow
nodes.notes: Reuse path: parent workflows (e.g. workflow.patch-dialogue-to-message.json) call this engine as a sub-workflow — no engine URL or webhook token to configure. The item passed in has the same shape as the webhook body.

nodes.name: Get movie for campaign
nodes.notes: Movie-id-only call (e.g. "patch this grid movie"): derive the campaign from the movie itself — the caller shouldn't need to know it.

nodes.name: List campaigns
nodes.notes: Only runs when userId is in the payload. Provides the owned list (ownership check + adopt-by-name) and the trailer/template id (entry.template.id — get-campaign lists only numbered episodes).

nodes.name: Import campaign
nodes.notes: One-time fallback only — reached when no owned campaign matches the name and importData was supplied.

nodes.name: Switch campaign mode
nodes.notes: Episode mode only: generation auto-chains only in basic mode. Best-effort (onError: continue) — we own the campaign, but don't fail the run over it.

nodes.name: Get campaign movies
nodes.notes: Also the re-entry point of the season-wait loop (Wait 10s → here → Resolve target).

nodes.name: Create season
nodes.notes: create-new-season (slots all rendered) or gen-movie-season (fresh campaign, seeded from the template). Runs at most once per execution — Resolve target checks whether this node already fired before asking again.

nodes.name: Get scenes
nodes.notes: Current scene values — used by patch mode to map sceneNumber → id AND to skip no-op edits. (Episode mode: a fresh slot has no scenes; harmless.)

nodes.name: Execute change
nodes.notes: Runs the planned calls strictly in order (batchSize 1) — styling relies on update-scene-background-color landing before rerun-scene.

nodes.name: Apply changes
nodes.notes: patch: diff-aware update-scene-* (dialogue→subtitle→burn · story→image→movie→burn · …). episode: set-movie-metadata plot + gen-movie-screenplay.

nodes.name: Generation progress
nodes.notes: patch → get-movie-scene-progress (stage counts). episode → get-movie-progress (the movieScreenplay execution is the completion signal, as the web app does).

nodes.name: Export render
nodes.notes: Concat all scenes + soundtrack into the final movie. force:true guarantees a stitched output (and, in episode mode, drives any per-scene renders still finishing).

nodes.name: Post to chat
nodes.notes: Slack/Discord/Teams incoming webhooks all accept { text }. onError=continue: a missing/broken chatWebhookUrl must not kill the run after the render already succeeded.

nodes.name: Return to caller
nodes.notes: Sub-workflow exit: the parent's Execute Workflow node receives this item ({ url, movieId, campaignId, mode, changed }). The Respond node must not run on this path — there is no webhook to answer.
